scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "yarn workspace @crm/frontend dev" "yarn workspace @crm/backend dev"

scripts.lint: yarn workspace @crm/backend lint && yarn workspace @crm/frontend lint

scripts.test: yarn workspace @crm/backend test && yarn workspace @crm/frontend test
